value_order: JSON: depth-first with dictionary keys sorted. Parquet: column order, then row order, descending into list-valued cells. The same traversal the structure digest uses, so a matching structure digest makes these values positionally comparable.
numeric_tolerance: |a-b| <= 1e-06 + 1e-06*|b|; non-finite values compared exactly. Engineering portability tolerance, not a scientific uncertainty interval.
